name: MINT Protocol
description: Universal work attestation + trust graph for autonomous agents. Attest free, verify paid: writing to the trust graph (register, attest, batch attest, feed, rate, recommend, discover) is free — the distribution channel; reading it (verify, trust score/history/compare) is the paid product.
tagline: Attest free. Verify paid. The trust graph grows with every free attestation — reading it is where the value lives.

free.name: mint_register
free.description: Register an actor with a persistent cryptographic identity

free.name: mint_attest
free.description: Anchor a completed unit of work on Solana (free, unlimited)

free.name: mint_batch_attest
free.description: Anchor many work items in one call (free)

free.name: mint_recommend
free.description: Endorse an actor in a named context (free)

free.name: mint_discover
free.description: Trust-ranked search of the actor directory (free)

paid.name: mint_verify
paid.description: Verify an attestation against the chain
